5번째 가로줄과 5번째 세로줄은\n5번 박스의 이 칸에서 만납니다.\n이:
Row 5 and column 5
meet at this cell in box 5.
Let's call it the middle cell.
가로줄에서 1이 들어갈 수 있는 칸은\n박스 안 두 칸과 박스 밖 한 칸:
In the row, 1 can go in two cells
inside the box and one cell outside it.
세로줄에서도 1은 박스 안 두 칸과\n박스 밖 한 칸에 들어갈 수 있습니:
In the column too, 1 can go in two cells
inside the box and one cell outside it.
만약 1이 가운데 칸에도\n박스 밖 두 칸에도 들어가지 않으면\n가로줄의:
If 1 goes neither in the middle cell
nor in the two cells outside the box,
the row's 1 and the column's 1
both go in the other cells inside the box.
Then the box gets two 1s,
which can't happen.
그래서 1은 가운데 칸과 박스 밖 두 칸,\n이 세 칸에 적어도 한 번:
So 1 goes at least once in these three cells:
the middle cell and the two cells outside the box.
In the row, outside the box,
only one cell
can hold 2 and 3.
세로줄에서도 박스 밖에 2와 3이\n들어갈 수 있는 칸은\n한 칸뿐입니다:
In the column too, outside the box,
only one cell
can hold 2 and 3.
만약 2와 3이 가운데 칸에도\n박스 밖 두 칸에도 들어가지 않으면\n가:
If 2 and 3 go neither in the middle cell
nor in the two cells outside the box,
the row's 2 and 3 and the column's 2 and 3
all go in the other cells inside the box.
Then the box gets two 2s and two 3s,
which can't happen.
그래서 2와 3도 가운데 칸과 박스 밖 두 칸,\n이 세 칸에 적어도 한:
So 2 and 3 also go at least once each
in these three cells: the middle cell
and the two cells outside the box.
1, 2, 3이 세 칸에 적어도 한 번씩 들어가는데\n칸이 세 개에 숫자:
1, 2, 3 each go at least once in the three cells.
There are three cells and three digits,
so the three cells share 1, 2, 3.
So remove the other notes from the three cells.
박스 밖에서 세 숫자가 들어갈 칸이\n가로줄과 세로줄에 한 칸씩뿐인 곳을:
Find where the three digits have only one cell outside the box in both the row and the column.
Tap the middle cell and the two cells outside the box.
이 칸을 지나는 가로줄은 박스 밖에 세 숫자가 들어갈 칸이 없어요. 가운: The row through this cell has no cell outside the box for the three digits. Both lines through the middle cell need one such cell outside the box.
Right. That cell outside the box can hold the three digits.
With this cell, the three digits don't fit in just one cell outside the box.
이 칸을 지나는 세로줄은 박스 밖에 세 숫자가 들어갈 칸이 없어요. 가운: The column through this cell has no cell outside the box for the three digits. Both lines through the middle cell need one such cell outside the box.
Right. That is the middle cell where the two lines meet.
찾은 세 칸의 메모를 보세요.\n이제 다른 메모를 지울 수 있는 칸을 눌:
Look at the notes in the three cells you found.
Now tap a cell where other notes can be removed.
Right. You found all three cells.
That cell is outside the three cells. Look inside the three cells for notes to remove.
맞아요. 세 칸은 4, 6, 7이 나눠 가져서 이 칸의 메모 9는 지워져: Right. The three cells share 4, 6, 7, so note 9 is removed from this cell.
Every note in this cell is one of the three digits. There is no note to remove.
1. Find a row and a column that meet
at a middle cell inside a box.
2. 두 줄에서 박스 밖에 세 숫자가 들어갈 칸이\n한 칸씩뿐인지 확인합:
2. Check that each line has only one cell
outside the box for the three digits.
3. The three digits share the three cells,
so remove the other notes from those cells.
세 숫자가 한 칸에서 가로줄과 세로줄로\n불꽃처럼 퍼져 나가는 모양이라\:
The three digits burst from one cell
into a row and a column like fireworks,
so this is called a Triple Firework.
